title: The Eel Wife
text: A woman with eels for hair rises from the black water, the eels coiling and uncoiling around her face. Her eyes are flat and silver. She asks, very gently, after someone the sea once claimed, and she is looking at one of you as she says it.

options.label: The one with the sea in their blood answers her, as kin to kin.

outcomes.text: She knows their blood. She kisses their brow and gives them a pearl the size of an eye, which watches them.

options.label: The best liar lies to her, and hopes the sea does not know the truth.

outcomes.text: She believes it and sinks away. The eels go still.
She does not believe it. The eels uncoil.

options.label: Strike first, before she can ask again.

outcomes.text: The water boils with eels, every one of them hers.
